answer: What survives to the harbor is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. A quill of per-task receipts records who did what, and the whisper of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, slashed on a failed audit.
